items.title: Marty Morell interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 24, 2017
items.q: The transcript identifies Monk Rowe as the interviewer and Marty Morell as the interviewee. No personal or professional relationship beyond the interview context is described in the provided text.

ctx.x: Marty was interviewed in Orlando, Florida on February 24, 2017 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Orlando, Florida, and I’m very privileged to have Marty Morell with me today. And I’m going to introduce you as a man who wears lots of hats, including the cap you have on today.
